[1/2] Add instant Space-to-retry on the finish/time-up screen (R still returns to course select) with a clear HUD prompt, failing-first tests and README update.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: no new public symbols; only existing start/restart action behavior on terminal states; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: session best and selected course must survive the retry
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing tests for finish, failure, mid-race start, HUD prompt and R fallback before editing; keep reset() so records and course persist; run the full 48-test suite and the project gate.

description: Instant Space-to-retry on finish/time-up (R still returns to course select); HUD prompt and README updated. 54 unit tests pass; scripted full-drive retry demo passes; all 5 project gates pass after regenerating the stale codebase map. Tree intentionally left uncommitted (no commit/push authorization).
[1/2] Record checkpoint split times with each session best and show a +/- delta against the best run in the checkpoint message; per-course, session-only, with failing-first tests and README update.

impact_assessment.why: The game reports +12 SEC at a checkpoint but gives no comparison with the player's best run, so a time trial offers no intermediate progress feedback.
impact_assessment.benefits: Drivers see immediately whether they are ahead or behind at each checkpoint; best splits are kept per course and survive the one-key retry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds private state and a private finish helper only; snapshot shape unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: splits are session-only and must reset per run
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for split storage, delta text, per-course isolation, restart clearing and slower-finish retention; keep the existing checkpoint message byte-identical when no reference split exists; run all 5 project gates.

description: Checkpoint split comparison: each session best now stores per-checkpoint times and later runs show +/- seconds against that best in the checkpoint message; per-course, session-only, reset per run. 59 tests pass, scripted two-run split demo passes, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).

[1/2] Add a session-best ghost car: record a lightweight position trace for each run, keep the trace of the best run per course, interpolate it by elapsed time and render a distinct ghost node in the Keystone scene; failing-first tests and README update.

impact_assessment.why: Split deltas give numbers but no spatial sense of where a run gained or lost time; a ghost makes the best run visible on the same course.
impact_assessment.benefits: Drivers see their best run's line and pace directly; purely session-local, no save-format change; reuses the existing scene and update loop.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds private state, one private helper and one scene node; snapshot unchanged; dependency: stdlib interpolation only; concurrency: none; state: traces must reset per run and only the best trace is retained
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for trace capture, interpolation, clamping, per-course isolation, reset and slower-run retention; keep the ghost hidden without a best trace; run all 5 project gates.

description: Session-best ghost car: per-run position traces stored for each course best, interpolated by elapsed time and rendered as a distinct cyan ghost node; hidden without a best trace and reset per run. 65 tests pass, scripted ghost demo shows it falling behind on a boosted run, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
[1/2] Add a NEW BEST banner on the finish screen when a run sets a session best, and show distance to the next checkpoint (or finish) in the race HUD; failing-first tests and README update.

impact_assessment.why: Players cannot tell from the end screen whether they beat their session record, and the HUD shows which checkpoint was passed but not how far the next one is.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clear achievement feedback and actionable pace information during the run; no changes to simulation or storage.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one public helper and one private flag only; snapshot unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: new-best flag must clear on restart and on slower finishes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for banner presence/absence/reset and marker values at each checkpoint; keep existing label positions to avoid HUD overlap; run all 5 project gates.

description: HUD clarity: NEW BEST banner on a record finish and NEXT checkpoint/finish distance readout during the race; 69 tests pass, HUD label demo verified each state, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).

impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing tests for flash on collision, no flash on checkpoint, restore on expiry and restore on restart; capture base materials per node; run all 5 project gates.

description: Collision visual feedback: car parts switch to a red emissive material while the collision message is active and restore on expiry or restart; 72 tests pass, flash demo verified base/hit/expiry/checkpoint colours, all 5 project gates pass. Left uncommitted (no commit authorization).
